plugins.name: deeppairing
plugins.description: Delegate implementation without losing the decisions that matter: a local companion UI where Claude Code's findings, specs, options, and plans are shaped with you. Rejected approaches are checked by words and a short synonym list, not meaning: a matching present_* proposal is refused with your reason quoted back, a matching direct edit gets a permission prompt (it asks, it doesn't refuse), and, once you enable cross-project publishing, other projects get an advisory nudge, never a block.
